style: Keep EXACTLY the same fox mascot character from the reference: same orange-and-white fur, sly narrowed eyes and smug grin, black baseball cap, gold chain, same clean vector mascot illustration style with bold dark outlines, flat colors and soft highlights, same orange-and-black brand palette on a dark charcoal background. Different pose and composition from the reference. Absolutely no text, letters or numbers anywhere.

Different pose and composition from the reference. Absolutely no text, letters or numbers anywhere.
